title: Credit Invoice renders the current design, not the credited invoice’s

results.comment:

What was checked: how a credit document behaves when the shop changes its look. What happened: there is no credit document on this shop to look at. Raising a credit from a job offers a form about money and returned parts - a date, an amount, store credit or refund, a reason, and which parts are coming back - and it records a credit against the customer.
